response.overview: RITUALISTIC TENDENCIES is the first full length surf film starring the RITUAL VISION surf team and friends.  Filmed over the course of one year, the first year of RITUAL VISION.  Brought to you from the brains of Wade Carroll and Dion Agius.  Inspired by the surf films of the past, RITUALISTIC TENDENCIES has followed and documented the Ritual team all around the globe, exploring far reaches in the search for uncrowded perfection and some of the worlds most ripable waves.  Captured by surf film-maker and cinematographer Wade Carroll, and back up camera man / side kick Dion Agius. The film features footage of some of the best surfers in the world captured by some of the best cinematographers in surfing to give you the full blown surf amp-up experience.
response.title: RITUALISTIC TENDENCIES
